lines.en: I sweep my tail through a gap in the coral.

lines.zh: 鳍张开，我在水里慢慢滑。
lines.en: Fins spread, I glide slowly through the water.

lines.zh: 红色的草甸里，我看不清路。
lines.en: In the red meadow I can barely see the way.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁面走，避开空水。
lines.en: I hug the reef face, away from open water.
My spines stand up; touching them hurts.

lines.zh: 我一次只挪半条尾巴的距离。
lines.en: I move half a tail length at a time.
One flick of the tail and I turn.
Water passes my gills; I am in no hurry.
An anemone ahead; I go around it.
I follow the base of the reef for a path.

lines.zh: 上面的鱼太大，我压低身子。
lines.en: The fish above is too big; I keep low.

lines.zh: 沙地上有影子滑过，是鲨鱼。
lines.en: A shadow slides over the sand: a shark.

lines.zh: 我钻进珊瑚枝，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I slip into the coral and show only my eyes.

lines.zh: 水变凉了，我知道到深一点了。
lines.en: The water cools; I have reached deeper ground.

lines.zh: 我把胸鳍当手，一撑一撑地走。
lines.en: I use my pectoral fins like hands, pushing along.

lines.zh: 红草晃了一下，我穿了过去。
lines.en: The red grass sways once, and I've passed through.

lines.zh: 从礁石上翻下去，我不用鳍划。
lines.en: I tumble off the reef and don't need to paddle.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝太窄，我张开刺慢慢挤。
lines.en: The coral gap is narrow; I spread my spines and squeeze.

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚上方，鳍微动。
lines.en: I hover above the coral, fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 有条小虾在石缝里，我盯着。
lines.en: A small shrimp is in the crack; I stare.

lines.zh: 只要鳍不摆，我就是一块珊瑚。
lines.en: If my fins hold still, I am just another piece of coral.

lines.zh: 棘刺上的条纹在水里散开。
lines.en: My striped spines blur in the water.

lines.zh: 我嘴边的水一动，我醒了。
lines.en: Water near my mouth moves; I wake.
The coral's shadow shields me from the light.
I wait for the churn after the tide turns.

lines.zh: 红草甸的颜色把我的鳍藏住。
lines.en: The red meadow hides the color of my fins.
I count the little fish swimming past.
One is too large; I put it out of mind.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，看清底下。
lines.en: I tilt my body to see the bottom clearly.
The surface is far, and I do not go there.
I fan my fins lightly to hold position.
A tapping sound comes from inside the reef.

lines.zh: 你浮在水里，比我大太多。
lines.en: You float in the water, far larger than me.

lines.zh: 我竖起棘刺，先告诉你别碰。
lines.en: My spines rise: do not touch me.

lines.zh: 你的护目镜反光，我看不清眼。
lines.en: Your goggles glare; I cannot see your eyes.

lines.zh: 那网一抖，我就知道要躲。
lines.en: The moment that net shakes, I know to hide.
You come slowly and I retreat as slowly.

lines.zh: 我只有六点血，你该知道。
lines.en: I have six points of health; you should know that.

lines.zh: 你搅起沙，我看不见你了。
lines.en: You stirred the sand and I lost sight of you.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我怕你身后的影子。
lines.en: I fear not you, but the shadow behind you.
Stop moving, and I will turn back.
We watch each other across a stretch of water.
One of my spines has snapped.
That knocked me onto the sand.
Scales came off and pale flesh shows.

lines.zh: 我六点的身体经不住几下。
lines.en: Six points of body will not take many hits.
Blood spreads in the water, which is dangerous.
I shrink into the coral, fins still shaking.
I did not even see who struck me.
It hurts, but I still have to swim.
My spines went limp and will not stand.
Stop chasing; I am nearly spent.
That is shrimp; I can taste it in the water.
A small piece of flesh suits my mouth.
Wave it and I will follow.
I do not eat plants; keep the seaweed.
The scent is too strong; a little suspicious.

lines.zh: 低一点，别举在我头顶上。
lines.en: A little lower; do not hold it above my head.
I take a bite and leave, no pestering.
The taste of shelled things is my favorite.
Keep your hand steady; I will swim over.
Done eating, I should return to the coral.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的棘刺了，疼的是你。
lines.en: You hit my spines; the pain is yours.
The water pushed me onto my side.
Do not crowd me with your body; I am small.

lines.zh: 我撞上珊瑚，鳞片掉了一片。
lines.en: I struck coral and lost a scale.
You move and the whole water sways.

lines.zh: 一边的胸鳍压在石头下面。
lines.en: One pectoral fin is trapped beneath the stone.

lines.zh: 我退到珊瑚后面躲一下。
lines.en: I back behind the coral to hide.

lines.zh: 撞得我滑出两个珊瑚枝的距离。
lines.en: The hit slid me two coral branches away.

lines.zh: 我甩尾稳住，差点翻过来。
lines.en: I flick my tail and nearly flip over.
Your knee touched my back.
Its stripes are darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在珊瑚枝间并排游。
lines.en: We swim side by side between coral branches.
I spread my fins, and it spreads its own.
In the red meadow we circle each other.
It leads; I follow behind.

lines.zh: 我们把卵放在珊瑚下面。
lines.en: We set our eggs beneath the coral.
It nudged my flank with its mouth.

lines.zh: 两条影子落在同一块石上。
lines.en: Two shadows settle on the same stone.

lines.zh: 别的鱼靠近，我们一起竖刺。
lines.en: When another fish nears, we raise spines together.

lines.zh: 水凉的时候，我们靠得近。
lines.en: When the water cools, we stay close.
Mind the spines; they carry venom.

lines.zh: 你捏住我的尾巴，我挣不开。
lines.en: You pinched my tail, and I cannot pull free.
I am slippery; you will fumble me.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳍贴在身上。
lines.en: Out of water my fins flatten to my body.

lines.zh: 你手心的水，还能让我呼吸。
lines.en: The water in your palm still lets me breathe.
I slap my tail and splash your face.
Six points of body is very light.

lines.zh: 别把我跟别的鱼放一起。
lines.en: Do not put me in with the other fish.
Holding me by the dorsal fin works.
At the water's edge I will swim off myself.

lines.zh: 那只虾离石头只有一寸。
lines.en: That shrimp is an inch from the stone.

lines.zh: 小鱼群散了，落单的好抓。
lines.en: The school scattered; the straggler is easy.
I fix on the smallest one.
Its shell is thin; I can bite through.
I flatten my fins and sink slowly.
That thing moves, but it is not a fish.
I choose the angle where its back is turned.
The current hides my shadow.

lines.zh: 这一带的小东西都归我。
lines.en: The small things in this patch are mine.
It has gone still, so I will move.

lines.zh: 我一点一点靠近，鳍不动。
lines.en: I close in bit by bit, fins still.

lines.zh: 它抬头了，我停在珊瑚后。
lines.en: It looked up; I stop behind the coral.

lines.zh: 我的条纹和水草混在一起。
lines.en: My stripes blend with the weeds.
Half an inch closer and it is in my mouth.

lines.zh: 它往左，我提前绕到左边。
lines.en: It goes left; I swing left first.

lines.zh: 沙地上我的影子太清楚。
lines.en: My shadow on the sand is too clear.
I wait for it to leave the stone.
It began digging, conveniently distracted.
My mouth is open; slowly now.
Tail tensed, one dash and I arrive.

lines.zh: 一口咬住，棘刺同时立起。
lines.en: One bite, and my spines rise at once.

lines.zh: 牙不大，但每一下都落在关节。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but each lands on a joint.

lines.zh: 它甩了两下尾巴，然后软了。
lines.en: It slapped its tail twice, then went limp.
Three points of damage is enough.
I rake its shell with a spine.
I missed and only tore off a fin.
It rammed me and met my spines.
Blood is in the water; I withdraw.
I swallow, and my throat is a bit full.
Done, I leave; sharks will come.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁的枝丫间，我出生。
lines.en: I was born among coral branches.
The red meadow's water raised me too.

lines.zh: 我和另一条一起被浪送来。
lines.en: The surf brought me and one other.
Colors are many here; hiding is easy.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到的是珊瑚。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was coral.
Shallow, bright water means many small fish.
I came out of a crack in the reef.
That shark patrols far off.
I found a corner sheltered from the current.
The bleached coral unsettles me.
The water heats and my gills burn.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔下，鳍先着地。
lines.en: I fell from the surface, fins first.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的鳃盖贴死了。
lines.en: Out of water my gill covers clamp shut.
The blast shattered the coral into pieces.

lines.zh: 箭贴着背鳍过去，刮掉几片鳞。
lines.en: The arrow passed my dorsal fin and scraped off scales.
That gleam made my scales stand.
Three days without shrimp and I weaken.
Lightning hit the lagoon; I went rigid.
The coral is gone, leaving only black.
